then.say: You made it! Told you I'd be here. Look at this: a real stall. Well. A table with a roof.
I owe you. When I've got stock worth selling, you get first pick. Powder, shot, the good stuff.

else.say: My favourite customer. My only customer, but still.

do.say: Nothing yet. My real stock is hidden where the Order will never look. When I can reach it, you'll be the first to know.

menu.text: How did you end up on that wagon?

do.say: Sold powder to the wrong priest. Or the right priest, and he got caught. Either way the Order needed a penitent, and I was handy.
Mind the Hill Stair. Things come down it after dark.
